_description: Preset profiles for one-command optimization via -Profile flag.

Safe.description: Conservative optimization. Only applies safe-tier tweaks with zero breakage potential.

Gaming.description: Optimized for gaming. Applies safe performance tweaks plus game-specific settings.
Gaming.notes: Enables Game Mode, disables Game Bar overlays, sets High Performance power plan.

Privacy.description: Maximum privacy. Applies all safe and moderate privacy tweaks.
Privacy.notes: Includes DiagTrack disable. May affect Xbox achievements and Game Pass.

Custom.description: User-defined profile. Launches interactive menu for manual tweak selection.
Custom.notes: All modules and risk tiers available for manual selection.
